summary: A stale catalog version blocks the retinol caution even though both IDs are in version 2.

findings.explanation: Proposed. example-retinol was stored with catalog version 1. The active catalog is version 2, so its IDs were not used as matches.
findings.reason: Proposed. catalogVersion does not equal the catalog version passed to the engine.
limitations: Proposed rules only. This is not a team-approved safety assessment. Severity, when present, is display priority and not a clinical grade.
